architectural_revision_if_needed: Replace V0(in_bounds) and V2(no_duplicate_cells) in the k=3 ensemble with structurally independent verifiers that have non-trivial fail modes on the quadrant-anchor decoder output. Candidates: (a) V3: require each written color differs from the original color at that cell — makes V1 and V3 jointly necessary for acceptance; (b) V4: require no two adjacent actions target neighbouring cells — orthogonal to the change check. Root cause: snap_to_action quadrant anchors structurally guarantee V0 and near-guarantee V2, so they provide no independent discriminative signal. Per Spera Theorem 9.2 (arXiv:2603.15973): verifier ensembles must be designed for joint-kernel orthogonality, not just individual coverage.
failure_modes_discovered: pairwise_verifier_correlation: max P(V_i|V_j) = 1.000 >= 0.70 — correlated blind spots detected; the quadrant-anchor decoder structurally guarantees V0 (in_bounds) for all inputs and V2 (no_duplicate_cells) for most, making their co-occurrence vacuous and reducing effective independent coverage from k=3 to approximately k=1 (only V1 changes_grid provides genuinely independent signal)
